title: crepis taraxacifolia subsp. hyemalis
intro: Crepis taraxacifolia subsp. hyemalis, commonly known as winter hawk's-beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are thought to aid in the treatment of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Crepis taraxacifolia subsp. hyemalis are attributed to its ability to stimulate the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
